productionReports.title: Production Reports
productionReports.datesRequired: From and To dates are required.
productionReports.noByProductsForBatch: No by-products recorded for this batch.
productionReports.noClosedBatches: No closed batches found for this period.
productionReports.noMaterialConsumptions: No material consumptions found for this period.
productionReports.noLedgerExpenses: No ledger expenses found for this period.
productionReports.noByProductsOffset: No by-products offset found for this period.
productionReports.batchesReceivingExpense: Production batches receiving this expense allocation
productionReports.batchesProducingByProduct: Production batches producing this by-product offset

help.materialProduct: Material used in production. Expand to see which batches consumed this material.
help.materialUnit: Measurement unit used to quantify the consumed material.
help.materialTotalQty: Total quantity of this material consumed across the selected period.
help.materialAvgUnitCost: Average unit cost applied to this material across all included batches.
help.materialTotalCost: Total production cost contributed by this material in the selected period.
help.materialBatch: Production batch that consumed the material.
help.materialBatchDate: Batch closing date used for the report.
help.materialBatchQty: Material quantity consumed by the batch.
help.materialBatchUnitCost: Cost per unit of material applied to the batch.
help.materialBatchTotal: Total material cost charged to the batch.
help.ledgerName: Expense ledger allocated to production. Expand to inspect batch-level postings.
help.ledgerCurrency: Currency used for this ledger expense.
help.ledgerTotal: Total ledger expense allocated to production in the selected period.
help.ledgerBatch: Production batch receiving this expense allocation.
help.ledgerDate: Batch closing date used for the allocation.
help.ledgerQty: Allocation quantity or usage basis tied to the expense.
help.ledgerRate: Expense rate applied before currency conversion.
help.ledgerExchangeRate: Conversion rate used when the ledger expense currency differs from the base currency.
help.ledgerBatchTotal: Total expense amount allocated to the batch.
help.ledgerRemarks: Additional note captured on the expense allocation.
help.totalMaterialCost: Combined cost of all raw and packaging materials consumed by the selected production batches.
help.totalExpenseCost: Total overhead and other ledger expenses allocated to the selected production batches.
help.byProductOffset: Estimated value recovered from by-products, used to reduce the net production cost.
help.netProductionCost: Final production cost after adding materials and ledger expenses, then subtracting by-product offset.
help.costBreakdown: Visual split of the total production cost between materials, ledger expenses, and by-product offset.
help.materialConsumptions: Grouped material usage totals. Expand the section or a row to inspect batch-level material consumption.
help.ledgerExpenses: Grouped non-material costs allocated from ledgers. Expand the section or a row to inspect batch-level expense allocations.
help.byProductsOffset: Value recovered from secondary outputs that offsets the overall production cost.
help.byProductUnit: Measurement unit used for the by-product quantity.
help.byProductTotalQty: Total by-product quantity generated in the selected period.
help.byProductCostReduction: Market value credited back against production cost because of the by-product output.
